name: alphadesk-qa-harness
description: Structured Playwright QA harness for AlphaDesk. Walks every route in qa/test-plan.md, exercises documented interactions, and writes a full run manifest (PNG + DOM + console + network) to qa/runs/<timestamp>/.
notes: Do NOT `npm install` here — Playwright is already resolved from the repo-root node_modules. This file exists for documentation / future extraction only.
